runs.title: HTTP caching basics — dated baseline
runs.summary: Established the dated standards-grounded baseline for freshness and reuse, stale responses, conditional validation, private versus shared storage, and common Cache-Control mistakes.

runs.title: Follow-up: ETag versus Last-Modified precedence
runs.summary: Added the narrow validator comparison: If-None-Match wins, a nonmatching ETag prevents date fallback, and the curl matrix is expected rather than measured because curl was unavailable.

runs.title: Cache-key & privacy mismatch
runs.summary: Added the query, Vary, Cookie, Set-Cookie, and Authorization worksheet, separated expected protocol outcomes from a local key/match model, and documented why no live shared-cache measurement is claimed.
